question: As of August 2022, who among the following is the Chairman of Tata Trusts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ratan Tata**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of August 2022, the Chairman of Tata Trusts is **Ratan Tata**.
 
• He had served as the **Chairman of Tata Trusts for many years, **and while he stepped down from the leadership of Tata Group in 2012, he continued his role at the Trusts, steering its philanthropic initiatives.
 
• Ratan Tata was born on December 28, 1937.
 
• His father's name was Naval Tata who was adopted by Ratanji Tata - son of Jamshedji Tata, the Tata group founder.
 
• Ratan Tata joined the Tata group in 1961, and his first position was managing operations on the shop floor of Tata Steel.
